The incident highlights ongoing safety risks associated with small-scale and illegal mining operations in remote Indonesian territories, which remain difficult for government regulators to monitor. Local state-owned mining enterprise Antam clarified that the accident occurred entirely outside its authorized operational footprint.

stories.title: برطانوی حکومت سے پنشن پانے والی آخری خاتون جنت خاتون انتقال کر گئیں
stories.summary:
برطانوی راج کے دور سے پنشن حاصل کرنے والی آخری زندہ خاتون جنت خاتون قائم خانی 107 برس کی عمر میں انتقال کر گئی ہیں۔ ان کا تعلق پاکستان کے صوبہ سندھ کے شہر جھڈو سے تھا اور وہ 1919ء میں بھارتی ریاست راجستھان کے ضلع جھنجھنو میں پیدا ہوئی تھیں۔

جنت خاتون کے شوہر عبدالشکور قائم خانی پنجاب ہارس رجمنٹ میں سپاہی تھے اور دورانِ ملازمت ہی انتقال کر گئے تھے۔ شوہر کی وفات کے بعد برطانوی حکومت نے ان کی پنشن جنت خاتون کے نام منتقل کر دی تھی جو کہ اسی ہزار سے زائد تھی اور وہ کئی دہائیوں تک اقوام متحدہ کے توسط سے یہ پنشن وصول کرتی رہیں۔

مرحومہ جھڈو ٹاؤن کمیٹی کے سابق وائس چیئرمین عمر دراز قائم خانی کی والدہ تھیں۔ ان کی وفات کے ساتھ ہی برطانوی دورِ حکومت سے پنشن پانے والے خاندان کے اس تاریخی سلسلے کا بھی ایک دور ختم ہو گیا ہے۔

stories.title: کراچی: ایڈمن سوسائٹی میں عمارت گرنے کے بعد 17 افراد اب بھی لاپتہ
stories.summary:
کراچی کی ایڈمن سوسائٹی میں بلوچ کالونی کے قریب چھ منزلہ عمارت گرنے کے واقعے کے بعد تاحال 17 افراد لاپتہ ہیں۔ واقعے کا مقدمہ سرکار کی مدعیت میں ٹیپو سلطان تھانے میں درج کر لیا گیا ہے جس میں قتل، غفلت اور لاپرواہی کی دفعات شامل کی گئی ہیں۔ پولیس کے مطابق مقدمے میں دس افراد کو نامزد کیا گیا ہے جن میں سے چار کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا ہے۔

ریسکیو ذرائع کے مطابق اس حادثے میں اب تک 3 افراد جاں بحق جبکہ 14 زخمی ہوئے ہیں جنہیں ملبے سے نکال لیا گیا ہے۔ ڈی جی ریسکیو 1122 سندھ بریگیڈیئر ریٹائرڈ واجد صبغت اللہ مہر اور ایس ایس پی ایسٹ زبیر نذیر شیخ نے جائے وقوعہ کا دورہ کیا اور تمام دستیاب وسائل بروئے کار لاتے ہوئے امدادی کارروائیاں تیز کرنے کی ہدایت جاری کی ہیں۔

سندھ بلڈنگ کنٹرول اتھارٹی کے مطابق یہ رہائشی پلاٹ پر مبینہ طور پر غیر قانونی کمرشل تعمیرات تھیں اور حادثے کے وقت مزدور پانچویں منزل پر کام کر رہے تھے۔ عمارت کے مالک کے بھائی اور کنٹریکٹر سمیت 5 افراد کو حراست میں لیا گیا ہے جبکہ ایس بی سی اے کے 8 افسران کو بھی معطل کر دیا گیا ہے۔ کمشنر کراچی کو چوبیس گھنٹوں میں ابتدائی انکوائری رپورٹ پیش کرنے کا حکم دیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Balochistan Chief Minister Bugti Vows Firm Action Against State Opposition
stories.summary:
Balochistan Chief Minister Sarfraz Bugti stated that no leniency will be granted to individuals engaging in armed resistance or promoting terrorism, regardless of gender. Speaking to participants at the 28th National Security Workshop in Quetta, he addressed the region's security dynamics, governance hurdles, and development strategies, reaffirming that Balochistan remains an integral part of Pakistan.

Mr Bugti emphasized that violence and separatism cannot be excused under the guise of religion, nationalism, or historical deprivation. While acknowledging that uneven development and deprivation exist in the province, he insisted these issues must be resolved through democratic channels rather than unlawful force. He also differentiated between peaceful political dissent and armed insurgency, noting that killing innocent people and attacking state institutions lacks any ideological justification.

Addressing the younger population, Mr Bugti voiced concerns regarding anti-Pakistan factions operating from foreign soil to manipulate youth via social media propaganda. He encouraged students to prioritize education and constructive national involvement while looking past online narratives. The provincial government is actively working to expand access to quality education, economic prospects, and basic amenities in remote areas.

Chief Secretary Shakeel Qadir Khan also participated in the session, briefing attendees on administrative reforms and ongoing infrastructure projects designed to enhance public service delivery. Mr Bugti concluded by praising the sacrifices of local residents and security forces, promising that their efforts toward enduring peace and public grievance resolution will be honored.

stories.title: Russian Ballistic Missiles Strike Kyiv Shopping Centre and Buildings
stories.summary:
Russian military forces launched a series of ballistic missile strikes against the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv late on Wednesday. According to Mayor Vitali Klitschko, the bombardment targeted a shopping centre and two other buildings situated on the east side of the Dnipro River, which bisects the city.

Two separate sequences of loud explosions echoed across the capital, as confirmed by Reuters witnesses on the ground. Mayor Klitschko utilized the Telegram messaging platform to inform residents that the assault was ongoing and strongly advised everyone to remain inside secure bomb shelters until further notice.

The attack resulted in three reported injuries, with one victim sustaining serious wounds. Klitschko noted that at least one of the struck structures sustained heavy and severe damage as a result of the impacts.

This incident follows a persistent trend of regular Russian strikes targeting Kyiv and various other Ukrainian urban centers since September. Earlier in the week, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy stated that intelligence reports indicated Russian forces were actively preparing for another major offensive across the country. Both Moscow and Kyiv consistently deny intentionally targeting civilian infrastructure.

stories.title: PCB Overhauls Contract Structure to Rebuild Test Cricket Team
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has defended its new central contract structure, which shifts from traditional alphabetical grades to format-based categories. Aqib Javed, the PCB Director of High Performance, explained on a podcast that the change aims to engage players for specific formats over the coming year, enhancing focus and providing financial benefits.

The new system divides 38 contracted players into Test specialists, players competing in both Tests and ODIs, ODI and T20I players, and T20-only cricketers. Aqib emphasized that holding a central contract does not guarantee national selection and noted that the board may add more players following a three-month review. The strategy prioritizes long-term rebuilding for the next World Test Championship cycle after Pakistan finished ninth in the previous cycle, with experienced players like Shan Masood, Mohammad Rizwan, and Imam-ul-Haq excluded to foster younger options.

To counter the impact of T20 leagues on red-ball cricket, the PCB has tied contracts to mandatory domestic participation. Test specialists must play at least six first-class matches, while players in other formats have scaled red-ball requirements. Additionally, red-ball specialists will be restricted to the Pakistan Super League rather than overseas T20 leagues. Performance assessments will evaluate fitness, domestic duties, and a minimum impact score.

The board is also implementing development contracts to fast-track young talent, with separate domestic agreements designated for successful under-19 players returning from an England tour. A structured pathway from under-15 to under-21 cricket has been established to focus on skills, fitness, nutrition, sleep, and discipline.

stories.title: Duran Duran Guitarist and Songwriter Andy Taylor Passes Away at 65
stories.summary:
Andy Taylor, the prominent guitarist and songwriter for the British pop-rock band Duran Duran and a Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee, died on Monday at the age of 65. A joint statement released on Wednesday by his family and former bandmates confirmed that he passed away from metastatic prostate cancer.

Taylor co-authored several of the group's most iconic tracks, including "Hungry Like the Wolf," "Rio," and "Girls on Film." His wife, Tracy Wilson-Taylor, shared a tribute on behalf of the family, praising him as a wonderful husband, loving father, and proud grandfather. Members of the Grammy-winning band—Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes, John Taylor, and Roger Taylor—also paid tribute, highlighting his pivotal role in shaping the group's distinctive musical style and swagger from its earliest days in Birmingham.

Born in Tynemouth in 1961 and raised in Cullercoats, Northumberland, Taylor began playing the guitar at the age of 11. He eventually left school to tour England and Europe with different musical acts before relocating to Birmingham to join Duran Duran in 1980. The band secured a contract with EMI Records and released their self-titled debut album in 1981, achieving widespread international acclaim with their 1982 release, "Rio." Taylor later pursued a solo career, issuing his debut studio album titled "Thunder" in 1987.

Throughout his life, Taylor shared four children with his wife, Tracy Wilson-Taylor. His former bandmates commended him for facing his terminal illness with remarkable courage, honesty, and grace until the end.

stories.title: US Dollar Stabilizes in Asian Trading Amid Falling Treasury Yields
stories.summary:
The US dollar remained largely stable during Asian trading hours on Thursday after sliding to a one-week low overnight. The greenback's typical safe-haven appeal was countered by declining Treasury yields and fragile risk sentiment ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday closure.

The US dollar index hovered flat at 103.7, pulling back from a 19-month high reached earlier in the week when Jensen Huang's return as chief executive of Nvidia temporarily boosted artificial intelligence investments. Analysts noted that while hawkish Federal Reserve expectations continue to support the currency, shifting risk dynamics keep its trajectory volatile.

Market expectations for a 25-basis-point rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December—and potentially again in early 2027—were reinforced by strong domestic data, including hotter-than-expected core personal consumption expenditures inflation and an upward revision to third-quarter gross domestic product. Meanwhile, Treasury yields fell across the curve, with the 10-year yield dropping 10 basis points to a two-and-a-half-month low of 4.8%.

Other major currencies saw modest movements as thin liquidity characterized the holiday session. The euro traded near $1.097, the Japanese yen edged up 0.1% to roughly 159.06, and the Australian dollar recovered past 0.66. Concurrently, the Trump administration proposed new trade tariffs targeting 14 major trading partners to curb structural excess industrial capacity, with the heaviest rates directed at China. In commodities, Brent crude futures climbed 3.5% to $94.61 a barrel following reports of a Houthi attack on a Saudi Arabian oil refinery.

stories.title: Lahore High Court Demands Police Report on JUI-F Chief Confinement
stories.summary:
The Lahore High Court has intervened in the alleged confinement of Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, directing the capital police chief to submit a detailed report. Justice Ali Zia Bajwa took up the petition, which was filed by Advocate Chaudhry Abrar Hussain, a member of the JUI-F legal wing, after the politician was restricted to his temporary residence.

During the proceedings, Justice Bajwa stressed the seriousness of unlawful detention and warned that responsible individuals would face consequences. The petitioner maintained that Maulana Fazl was being held illegally and that his life and liberty faced threats, preventing him from attending a scheduled multiparty conference hosted by the Lahore High Court Bar Association.

Additional Advocate General Farrukh Javed Lodhi countered by noting that the petitioner had recently met the JUI-F leader, with a photograph of the interaction circulating online. Advocate Hussain explained that the meeting only occurred after repeated requests to the police for permission, though the politician remained unable to leave the property due to a heavy police contingent deployed outside.

Justice Bajwa ordered the Capital City Police Officer to present the comprehensive report. The case highlights ongoing political and legal tensions surrounding freedom of movement and security measures involving prominent opposition figures in the region.
